synopsis: The covert mission into Deatholme continues deeper into Scourge territory as Falanaras’s team presses on beneath the shadow of Kael’thas’s summons. After Rynel’s uncontrolled feeding, his gaunt, hunched appearance and fixation on nearby magic increasingly resemble a Wretched, though discipline and identity have not vanished completely. The records and anchor-stone reveal how Deatholme’s necromantic ward network coordinates the stronghold, and the team secures its objective before being caught during the withdrawal at a warded choke point. Already wounded and unable to keep pace, Rynel uses his established spellbreaker training and the sin’dorei’s normal combat practice of mana tapping to intercept the hostile magic holding the passage. He takes a deliberately bounded measure from the anchor to keep himself standing, then stops while greater power remains and directs the rest away from himself long enough for Falanaras, Theron, and Lethira to cross. After naming Falanaras as the one who must answer Kael’thas’s summons, Rynel severs the anchor and brings the passage down between the survivors and the pursuing Scourge. His final act does not erase his degeneration or grant easy redemption. It proves that a man nearing the loss of himself can still recover discipline, choose the limit, and decide what his remaining strength is for.
title: Chapter 6: Deatholme's Price
